title: Looking Beyond the Government’s Regulatory Toolkit: Early Findings on How Business and Civil Society Actors Can Help Manage and Mitigate Transformative Artificial Intelligence Risks and Impacts
summary_en: Transformative artificial intelligence presents safety and societal risks and has prospective benefits. The authors develop a structured framework for how industry and civil society can help manage and mitigate those risks.
title_cn: Looking Beyond the Government’s Regulatory Toolkit: Early Findings on How Business and Civil Society Actors Can Help Manage and Mitigate Transformative Artificial Intelligence Risks and Impacts

title: Why Human Intelligence Matters More in an AI World
summary_en: AI will become an indispensable tool for case officers, agents, fabricators, counterintelligence services, and the rest of the intelligence world. But this will have the paradoxical effect of increasing the importance of old-fashioned human intelligence.
title_cn: Why Human Intelligence Matters More in an AI World
